listingTitle: Pipishell Solid Wooden Coat Rack Freestanding with 8 Hooks, Brown
listingLines: More Hooks, Less Mess: Keep Coats, Bags and Hats off the Floor with 8 Hooks. From the tote bag and scarf you grab before leaving in the morning, to the last jacket of the evening, these 8 storage hooks help keep everyday items in one easy-to-reach place. The widened triangular base (≥19.7 ") ensures stability, while this coat rack freestanding gives you room to hang coats, backpacks, hats, and umbrellas.

Solid Wood, Steady Support: Stable Support, No Tipping, for Daily Use. When you come home with heavy backpacks and winter coats in hand, the last thing you want is a rack that wobbles. Upgraded with knot-free pine wood material, this coat rack stand offers higher strength and stability compared to regular wood, ensuring it won’t deform or wobble, even with heavy use. This hall tree is perfect for long-term reliability and daily storage.

Fits Kids and Adults: Right Height for Every Family Member, From Morning Rush to After School. In the morning, adults can grab coats and bags on the way out. After school, kids can hang backpacks and jackets by themselves. With 3 adjustable height options (39.8, 54.3, and 68.9 "), this hall tree fits real daily routines and turns clutter into an easy drop zone the moment you walk in.

Compact but Spacious: Made for Small Spaces That Need Real Storage. Struggling with clutter in a narrow entryway, apartment corner, or bedroom? This coat rack freestanding design (19.69"D x 19.69"W x 68.9"H) gives you the everyday function of a hall tree while taking up less space, so you can organize coats, bags, and hats without crowding the room.

Quick Setup, No Tools: Quick Setup When You Need Storage Right Away. Need extra storage today? This coat rack stand assembles quickly without tools, so you can start organizing right away. The smooth knot-free wood creates a sturdy connection, while the coat rack freestanding design adds clean, modern style to apartments, bedrooms, and entryways.
